boundary: Official/current docs evidence only; no provider settings changed and no secret values recorded.

sources.evidence: Pricing page lists Pro plan, compute pricing including Micro and Small, and PITR as a paid add-on starting around $100/month.
Backup docs state Pro projects can access 7 days of daily backups; PITR is an add-on, requires at least Small compute, replaces daily backups, and 7-day PITR is $100/month.
Domain docs describe SPF and DKIM as required for verification, DMARC as optional trust hardening, and MX as part of custom return-path/bounce/complaint handling.
Troubleshooting docs say to confirm required DKIM, SPF, and MX records when a domain is not verifying.

launchDecision.supabase: Use Pro daily physical backups plus off-repo logical dumps for the one-person closed beta; do not enable PITR unless owner accepts the add-on cost and downtime implications.
launchDecision.resend: Keep sender-domain verification blocked until send.contact MX/domain verification and delivery/webhook proof exist; do not disturb apex support email forwarding.
